instagram:
Patient registration should happen once. In most hospitals it happens at every counter: name, age and phone number at the front desk, again at the lab, again at billing, again on the IPD ward. Each desk keeps its own copy, and the patient spells it out one more time.

FineHealth by Fine Solves keeps one patient record from registration through OPD, IPD, reports and GST-ready billing, so every desk opens the same record instead of asking for the details again.

How many times does a patient at your hospital give their phone number before they go home?
